scope: Two ordinary input apps, native shell/57.6k disk, exact extracted OF816 bundle, physical edge timing and unobserved replay; separate four-layer native-panel cohort.

bank_zero_delta.baseline: AI6 emitted bank_zero_budget, byte-for-byte equal including guards/alignment/unused capacity
bank_zero_delta.historical_demo_budget_note: stack_budget.bank_zero_delta compares to the older compaction record and reports the already-established extra 1,536 bytes in slots 6/7. AI7 adds zero bytes.

timing_definitions.capture: Native pointer_notify: raw publication complete, before durable producer notification.
timing_definitions.route: AESMOUSE.Route entry in the existing presenter, before content classification/inbox publication.
timing_definitions.event_return: The emitted instruction immediately after InputRun calls evnt_multi; MU_BUTTON must be returned.
timing_definitions.visible: First completed-scanout observation whose entire 128 by 24 control matches the independent oracle and whose model has the requested armed state. Includes scanout/frame quantization.
timing_definitions.cpu: Exclusive caller/presenter service charge from capture to visible, including calls and bus stalls, excluding native interrupt bodies and other Tasks.
timing_definitions.provenance: One physical edge outstanding at a time, raw head/record and expected level, exactly one capture/route/button return in that edge interval, final activation count and independent peer unchanged.
timing_definitions.cohorts: 20 edges (10 presses and 10 releases) per load. Small development cohorts, not a latency qualification matrix.

replay.guest_timing_effect: Zero observed difference across all 60 aligned capture-observation-to-visible intervals; no guest instructions inserted.

native_panel.scope: Twelve measured edges, a further press/release with rapid A/B/C while drawing and reading, native Toggle progress, seven live Tasks, exact verified disk bytes and heap/owner recovery.

bundle.default_profile: No-option standard shell/PRIMES selection and existing counter profile preserved; their startup paths are unchanged, not rerun as full qualification.

frozen_builder.note: The frozen ZIP was built with the committed AI6 production builder. Later AI7 changes to that module only add development load/panel fixture options; application, wrapper, boot and other recorded production inputs are unchanged.

bundle.distribution_contents: Boot XEX, matching SYS/WORK disks, pinned ROM, short README, licenses and checksums only; no manifests, intermediates or test output.

limitations: PI4/HY4 remain open; this first ordinary GEM application redraw is intentionally untuned and still visibly slower than desired.
Visible times include scanout and observation bounds; timing stages are correlated per edge, but their distribution percentiles must not be added.
Calypsi 5.18 array-indexing defect remains recorded in AI6; no toolchain override or donor source changes.
